notes: Strict Chassagne-Montrachet specifications from the effective cahier des charges homologated by decree n°2011-1753. White and red wines are modeled separately at village and Premier Cru level. Conditional white fermentable-sugar relief to 4 g/L is conservatively fail-closed at the unconditional 3 g/L ceiling until the acidity condition is represented. Red accessory white grapes remain mixed-planting exceptions rather than ordinary cellar blend choices.
